language.label: Interface language
language.hint: Changes the language of the app. The project language — the one Kato asks and judges in — is set separately on the practice page.

entryGate.title: Put your name on this workspace.
entryGate.intro: Start immediately without creating an account. Your display name and guest rehearsal history stay in this browser unless you deliberately use the synced account option.
entryGate.nameRequired: Type the name you want on this workspace.
entryGate.syncTitle: Need your projects on another device?
entryGate.syncBody: The account page uses the configured authentication service for optional sync.
entryGate.asideQuote: “Bring the rubric you will actually be judged against.”

landing.title: Rehearse the claim a judge will challenge next.
landing.lede: Practise with Kato against the rubric you will actually be judged against.
landing.demoQuote: “Unlike generic delivery coaches, Talk-Active starts from the evaluator rubric.”
landing.demoCitation: Exact words from the rehearsal transcript
landing.demoGap: Name the closest alternative and the mechanism it lacks.
landing.demoQuestion: What makes this different from putting the same rubric into a general chat tool?
landing.useCase1Body: Connect product claims to the scoring rubric before the final Q&A.
landing.useCase2Body: Make each selection criterion explicit in the answer you rehearse.
landing.useCase3Body: Find where a method or conclusion still lacks a defensible explanation.
landing.useCase4Body: Any room where a written rubric decides the outcome.
landing.footerTagline: Rubric-grounded rehearsal for answers that need evidence.

account.title: Practise first. Sync only when it helps.
account.lede: An account is for continuity across devices. It never gates a first rehearsal.
account.guestTitle: Account sync is not configured here.
account.guestBody: Your local workspace remains fully usable. When the deployment has Postgres and an auth secret, this same screen enables account creation and sign-in.
account.passwordNote: Use 10–128 characters. Passwords are handled by Better Auth; Talk-Active does not place them in project or transcript records.
account.importLegacy: Bring in {count, plural, one {# browser project} other {# browser projects}}
account.deleteInstruction: Type {phrase} to remove the account, sessions, projects, and synced transcripts by database cascade. Local browser data is separate.
account.guide1Body: No account is required for a first run.
account.guide2Body: Account records live in the configured Postgres deployment, not inside transcripts.
account.guide3Body: Signing in does not change where configured model providers process criterion-scoped text.
account.boundaryBody: A camera-and-microphone replay is saved only after you opt in. Durable replay requires a signed-in owner and private storage; deleting it keeps the text feedback. Local work is separate.
account.statusCreated: Account created. This browser can now sync work when persistence is enabled.
account.statusRequestFailed: The account request could not be completed.
account.statusSignedOut: Signed out. Local guest mode remains available.
account.statusExported: Local browser data exported. Nothing was deleted.
account.statusImported: {projects} projects and {sessions} session summaries imported. The original browser data is still here.
account.statusImportFailed: The local workspace could not be imported.
account.statusDeleted: Synced account data was permanently deleted. Local browser data was left untouched.
account.statusDeleteFailed: The account data could not be deleted.

workspaceFrame.profileAnonymous: Put your name on this workspace

progressCharts.trendEmpty: Save a practice session to begin the evidence trend.

fillers.label: Filler frequency
fillers.measured: {count} configured filler events found in the transcript.

pauseRatio.label: Pause ratio
pauseRatio.absent: Audio pause observations were not supplied.

pitchVariation.label: Pitch variation
pitchVariation.measured: Calculated as standard deviation divided by mean pitch for voiced samples.
pitchVariation.absent: At least five voiced pitch samples are required.

energyVariation.label: Energy variation
energyVariation.measured: Calculated as standard deviation divided by mean RMS energy for non-silent samples.
energyVariation.absent: At least five non-silent energy samples are required.

trackingCoverage.label: Tracking coverage
trackingCoverage.measured: {tracked} of {sampled} sampled frames contained usable landmarks.

framingCoverage.label: Framing coverage
framingCoverage.measured: {framed} of {tracked} tracked frames met the mode framing rule. The framing rule changed on 17 August 2026: half body now counts as framed, so visual scores from before then are not comparable.
framingCoverage.absent: Usable landmarks are required before framing can be measured. The framing rule changed on 17 August 2026: half body now counts as framed, so visual scores from before then are not comparable.

movementActivity.label: Movement activity
movementActivity.measured: {active} tracked frames crossed the calibrated movement threshold.
movementActivity.absent: Usable landmarks are required before movement can be measured.

micQuality.silentBody: No signal at all. Check whether it is muted, or whether another device is selected.
micQuality.clippingTitle: This microphone is too loud and distorting
micQuality.clippingBody: The level is pinned, so words run together. Move back a little or turn the device gain down.
micQuality.noisyFloorBody: Something is audible between every phrase — usually a mic being held, vibrating, or resting on a desk. The recognizer has no silence to break sentences on. Try a stable surface, or the laptop microphone.
micQuality.tooQuietTitle: This is too faint to recognise
micQuality.tooQuietBody: There is sound, but very little of it. Move closer or turn the device gain up.
micQuality.boundary: This reads levels from our recording stream, not from the recognizer — echo and room reverb are not detected here.
micQuality.typedFallback: You can always type the transcript instead.
micQuality.guessedTitle: Some of this transcript was guessed
micQuality.guessedBody: The recognizer was unsure about {count, plural, one {# passage} other {# passages}}. Check and correct them before reviewing — a misheard passage gets quoted back as your own words.

progressView.title: Practice history
progressView.deliveryAndEvidenceSaved: Delivery observations and rubric evidence saved
progressView.emptyProject: No attempts saved to this project yet.
progressView.emptyProjectOrSummaries: No attempts or browser summaries have been saved to this project yet.
progressView.emptyGuest: No sessions saved in the production guest workspace yet.
progressView.needTwoAttempts: Save two reviewed attempts with criterion evidence to compare their exact quotes and gaps.
progressView.needAnotherAttempt: Complete another reviewed attempt before Talk-Active calls any gap recurring.
progressView.recurringBoundary: A criterion appears here only after at least two attempts left some required evidence implicit. Coverage describes this saved transcript history—not your ability.
progressView.movementBoundary: Movement describes explicit coverage in these two attempts—not confidence or ability.
progressView.steadyCoverage: Explicit coverage held steady on every criterion between these two attempts.
progressView.historicalOnly: Historical summary only. That session did not retain the original criterion quote or missing-cue list.
progressView.localBoundary: Local recurring gaps and comparisons use only criterion evidence retained in this browser. Older summaries stay labelled when their original quote or missing-cue list was never retained.
progressView.syncedBoundary: Recurring gaps and exact attempt comparisons use synced verdict rows only, with zero model calls. Project-scoped browser summaries appear only in the session count, coverage trend, and archive; separate interview answers remain page-local.

savedReview.checkingAccess: Checking access to this private review.
savedReview.couldNotOpen: This review could not be opened.
savedReview.unreadable: The server did not return a readable attempt review.
savedReview.startWithProof: Start with the proof. Fix one gap.
savedReview.keepDefensible: Keep the cited claims defensible and rehearse the hardest judge follow-up.
savedReview.everyCriterionAndState: Every rubric criterion and its evidence state
savedReview.exactSpanRetained: Exact transcript span retained with this verdict
savedReview.noSpanSupports: No transcript span supports this verdict.
savedReview.makeExplicitNext: Make this evidence explicit in the next rehearsal.
savedReview.noVerdicts: No rubric verdicts were retained for this attempt.
savedReview.coverageBoundary: This is evidence coverage in one transcript—not confidence, intelligence, or speaking ability.
savedReview.evidenceFirst: The exact rubric evidence comes first. Delivery observations remain supporting context and never change a criterion verdict.
savedReview.evidenceButNoDelivery: This attempt has rubric evidence but no saved delivery observation.
savedReview.savedFormatBoundary: This saved format retains inspectable counts, capture coverage, and timestamped cues. It does not retain the component bands needed to defend an aggregate delivery reading, so no vocal, visual, or overall score is shown. Camera, microphone, framing, and tracking quality affect what could be measured.
savedReview.rubricVoiceCamera: Rubric, voice, and camera on one clock
savedReview.timelineBoundary: The saved attempt retains clock positions for delivery cues. It does not retain word-level timing, so rubric citations stay visible above but are not given an invented timestamp here.
savedReview.noTimestampedRetained: No timestamped delivery cue was retained for this attempt.
savedReview.replayPreparing: The private replay is still being prepared. The saved evidence is already available.
savedReview.replayNotSaved: No replay was saved. The transcript, rubric evidence, and delivery observations remain available.
savedReview.replayStoreFailed: The replay could not be stored. The transcript, rubric evidence, and delivery observations were kept.
savedReview.observationsWithoutReplay: The observations remain readable without a replay. Timeline marks become playable only when the private video is ready.
savedReview.deleteOnlyVideo: Delete only the video? The transcript, delivery observations, and rubric evidence will remain.
savedReview.deleteFailed: The recording could not be deleted.
savedReview.deleted: The replay was deleted. Delivery observations, transcript, and rubric evidence were kept.
savedReview.cannotPlay: Your browser cannot play this saved rehearsal video.
savedReview.playFromBefore: Play the replay from two seconds before this.
savedReview.replayUnavailableCue: The replay is not available, so this cue cannot be played.

interviewSession.heading: Answer one rubric question at a time.
interviewSession.answerPlaceholder: Start with a direct answer, then give the evidence and why it matters…
interviewSession.waitPlaceholder: Begin this answer after Kato finishes speaking…
interviewSession.startOrType: Start optional capture below, or type without media.
interviewSession.captureRequired: Continuous capture must start before the first answer
interviewSession.captureBoundary: Camera and an optional replay share one timeline. Dictation and acoustic observations run only inside answer windows, never while Kato narrates.
interviewSession.pausedBoundary: Camera and the optional replay remain active between questions. Answer text and voice observations are paused while Kato speaks.
interviewSession.modelBoundary: No model request runs between questions. Final submit sends each answer only with its paired rubric criterion; Kato's question text is excluded. Separated turn transcripts and an optional replay remain page-local in this experimental flow; saved progress keeps the aggregate rubric summary.
interviewSession.answerNotSaved: This answer could not be saved.
interviewSession.pauseFirst: Pause the current answer before asking Kato to read the question.
interviewSession.narrationUnavailable: Audio narration is unavailable here; the complete question remains visible.
interviewSession.narrationStopped: Question narration stopped unexpectedly. The complete question remains visible as text.
interviewSession.semanticUnavailable: Semantic evidence mapping is unavailable, so the final batch will use labelled deterministic cue matching.
interviewSession.reviewFailed: The final interview review could not be completed.
interviewSession.reviewIncomplete: The final interview review did not map every answer back to its rubric criterion.
interviewSession.noCriterionEvidence: The deterministic interview review returned no criterion evidence.

multimodalReview.rubricVoiceCamera: Rubric, voice, and camera on one clock
multimodalReview.readAsText: Read the timeline and cited transcript as text
multimodalReview.markedTextBoundary: Marked text is copied from the transcript as text nodes; nothing is rewritten or injected as markup.
multimodalReview.noRubricTimeline: No rubric timeline was supplied for this attempt.
multimodalReview.noEvidenceCited: No evidence was cited for this criterion.
multimodalReview.noClockPosition: No citation was assigned a clock position; none is invented.
multimodalReview.noCandidateCrossed: No timestamped voice or camera candidate crossed the prototype thresholds.
multimodalReview.noTimingAvailable: No transcript or acoustic timing was available to read.
multimodalReview.evidenceStaysAbove: Rubric evidence and the next judge question stay above this panel. The observations here never change those verdicts.
multimodalReview.fullReadings: Full readings, weighting, limitations, and raw counts
multimodalReview.nothingMeasurable: Nothing measurable was observed in this attempt
multimodalReview.shadedZone: The shaded zone is the configured practice band; the mark is this attempt. A threshold comparison, not a pass or a fail.
multimodalReview.oneAttemptBoundary: This number describes one rehearsal attempt, not your ability.
multimodalReview.landmarkBoundary: Camera-landmark observation. Review the surrounding context before interpreting it.
multimodalReview.cameraUnavailable: Camera observations were unavailable for this attempt.
multimodalReview.cameraNotPart: The camera was not part of this attempt.
multimodalReview.noReplayKept: No camera-and-microphone replay was kept. The rubric evidence and timestamped observations above remain usable.
multimodalReview.timelineControls: Timeline controls start two seconds before an observation so you can judge its context yourself.
multimodalReview.playFromBefore: Play from two seconds before this.
multimodalReview.inspectMoments: Inspect the moments that may need another look.
multimodalReview.addMissingClaim: Add the missing claim without repeating the whole take.
